user.title: Avisos Meteocat
user.description: Set the location to monitor. Its comarca is resolved locally and only the comarca is stored.

data_description.location: Warnings are published per comarca; the marker only picks which one to follow.

comarca.title: Avisos Meteocat
comarca.description: The location could not be turned into a comarca. Pick the comarca you want to follow.

data_description.id_comarca: One entry per comarca. You can add more later for other places.

options.title: Avisos Meteocat
options.description: Tune which phenomena to follow and when to flag a warning as severe.

data_description.api_key: Leave blank to use the keyless public source. When set, the key is validated against the Meteocat API.
data_description.meteors: One sensor is created per selected phenomenon.
data_description.severe_threshold: Danger grade (1-6) at which the severe warning switches on. 3 is the official "Alt" band.
data_description.include_sea: Also follow the maritime zone in front of this comarca.
data_description.scan_interval: Minutes between updates. Leave blank for adaptive polling.

error.location_outside_catalonia: The location is outside Catalonia. Pick a comarca from the list.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Meteocat. Check your connection and try again.
error.invalid_geometry: The comarca map could not be read. Pick a comarca from the list.
error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check it and try again.
